questions.prompt: Which Egyptian structure was the tallest building on Earth for around 3,800 years?
questions.fact: It only lost the record to Lincoln Cathedral in England, whose spire later collapsed and was never rebuilt.

questions.prompt: What is the process by which plants lose water through their leaves?
questions.fact: A large tree can move hundreds of litres a day this way, and the pull is what drags water up from the roots.

questions.prompt: Which sport uses a ball with 32 panels in its traditional design?
questions.fact: The pattern of twenty hexagons and twelve pentagons became standard at the 1970 World Cup, chosen to show up on black-and-white television.

questions.prompt: Which film is set aboard the Nostromo?
questions.fact: The cast were not shown the creature before the chest scene, so their reactions are close to genuine.

questions.prompt: Which is the deepest lake in Africa?
questions.fact: It reaches over 1,400 metres and holds around 16 percent of the world's available fresh water.

questions.prompt: Which novel begins in a place called the Shire?
questions.fact: Its author drew the maps first and insisted the geography had to work before the plot could move through it.

questions.prompt: Which file format is designed for lossless image compression?
questions.fact: It was created specifically to replace GIF after the company holding GIF's compression patent began demanding fees.
